en.body: Cambridge Hospital organized team-building sessions for employees in Al Ain and Abu Dhabi. Through structured icebreakers, games and collaborative activities, colleagues strengthened working relationships and developed a greater sense of trust, teamwork and shared purpose across departments and facilities.
